description.value: Baker House is a University of the Fraser Valley residence building on the Abbotsford campus that opens to guest and group accommodation during the summer months. As a university dorm repurposed for travellers, it offers an affordable base in the Fraser Valley for cyclists passing through the region. Its seasonal availability and institutional setting make it a distinctive option compared to conventional hotels or B&Bs.
